key_insight: AI can unify fragmented experimental and theoretical knowledge to diagnose, model, and mitigate instability in 3D all-inorganic perovskites like CsPbX3.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps accelerate design of more stable perovskite solar cells, photodetectors, and LEDs by guiding materials selection and reliability engineering.
method: Microscopic mechanism analysis across coupled degradation pathways
Consequence/reliability prediction and engineering strategy optimization
evidence_signal: The review highlights that current studies are constrained by multimodal data, protocol dependence, sparse statistics, and uncertainty quantification, motivating AI-based analysis.
watch_item: Model transferability and benchmark consistency remain limited when data quality, test protocols, and domain conditions vary.
paper_title: Artificial Intelligence for Instability in Inorganic Perovskites: From Mechanism Discovery to Engineering Strategies
